LanguageData.RI_Backstory_CultivatorChild1.title: congenital cultivator
LanguageData.RI_Backstory_CultivatorChild1.descriptio: [PAWN_nameDef] has always been stronger, faster, wiser than normal children. A chance encounter with a passing martial artist revealed the spiritual roots twining through [PAWN_possessive] body and the Qi already suffusing [PAWN_possessive] breath, as if [PAWN_pronoun] had been practicing cultivation since birth.
LanguageData.RI_Backstory_CultivatorChild2.title: spirit bud implanter
LanguageData.RI_Backstory_CultivatorChild2.descriptio: [PAWN_nameDef] was born into a rich family who invested vast sums of wealth to acquire a spirit bud. Implanted under the care of elite surgeons, [PAWN_possessive] new spirit bud had vaulted them onto the path of cultivation.
LanguageData.RI_Backstory_CultivatorChild3.title: escaped experiment
LanguageData.RI_Backstory_CultivatorChild3.descriptio: For as long as [PAWN_nameDef] could remember, [PAWN_possessive] world was only incomprehensible experiments and featureless experimenters gazing in from observation rooms. The only brightness in [PAWN_possessive] life was an unexpected friendship with a single experimenter: the person who eventually helped them escape.
LanguageData.RI_Backstory_CultivatorChild4.title: spirit beast child
LanguageData.RI_Backstory_CultivatorChild4.descriptio: Raised as a human among spiritual beasts, [PAWN_nameDef] knew nothing about human niceties and plenty about which animals [PAWN_pronoun] could intimidate and which [PAWN_pronoun] could kill.
LanguageData.RI_Backstory_Child1.title: impoverished urchin
LanguageData.RI_Backstory_Child1.description: Long days of work besides [PAWN_possessive] family have sanded down the blisters on [PAWN_nameDef]'s thin hands. The people around [PAWN_objective] say [PAWN_pronoun] is a very sensible child, but poverty has simply made [PAWN_objective] grow up too early.
LanguageData.RI_Backstory_Child2.title: demonic child
LanguageData.RI_Backstory_Child2.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s brain worked in ways that were fundamentally incompatible with ordinary people, and [PAWN_pronoun] actively opposed anything people took pleasure in.
LanguageData.RI_Backstory_Child3.title: beloved child
LanguageData.RI_Backstory_Child3.description: [PAWN_nameDef] had a very happy childhood as [PAWN_pronoun] was beloved by [PAWN_possessive] family. [PAWN_pronoun] never had a hungry day in [PAWN_possessive] life and so grew to develop an optimistic mindset.
LanguageData.RI_Backstory_Child4.title: abnormal child
LanguageData.RI_Backstory_Child4.description: [PAWN_nameDef] came into the world, not with tears, but a clear-eyed observation of [PAWN_possessive] surroundings. [PAWN_pronoun] was frighteningly intelligent, often making comments and observations that not even the adults in the village could understand.
LanguageData.RI_Backstory_Child5.title: assassin trainee
LanguageData.RI_Backstory_Child5.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was orphaned early in life. [PAWN_possessive] misfortune only grew when [PAWN_pronoun] caught the eye of a shadowy organization that highly valued [PAWN_possessive] physical qualities and abducted [PAWN_objective] to be trained as an assassin.
LanguageData.RI_Backstory_Child_Yun1.title: Yun Clan descendant
LanguageData.RI_Backstory_Child_Yun1.description: The Yun Clan had already rebounded from devastation once under the leadership of Master Tianyun, in the wake of the ancient Sect Wars. But even that renewed prominence had faded into obscurity long ago.\n[PAWN_nameDef] was born into a humble family and only later learned of their distant connection to greatness. But [PAWN_pronoun] became determined to uplift [PAWN_possessive] family and the Yun Clan, just like Master Tianyun.
LanguageData.RI_Backstory_Child_Yun2.title: Yun diaspora descendant
LanguageData.RI_Backstory_Child_Yun2.description: After the fall of the Yun family in the ancient Sect Wars, a portion of the surviving descendants fled to distant lands and established new families.\nWhile perusing old books in [PAWN_possessive] family’s collection, [PAWN_nameDef] stumbled upon their forgotten history. Although [PAWN_possessive] family had abandoned all ties to the past, and even their ancestral surname, [PAWN_nameDef] made the resolute decision to venture into the cultivation world and seek out other surviving members of the Yun Clan.
LanguageData.RI_Backstory_CultivatorAdult1.title: cultivator
LanguageData.RI_Backstory_CultivatorAdult1.descriptio: Through the backing of [PAWN_possessive] family, [PAWN_nameDef] built a foundation to start learning the art of cultivation in adulthood. Now [PAWN_pronoun] has stepped onto the path of immortal cultivation.
LanguageData.RI_Backstory_CultivatorAdult2.title: loose cultivator
LanguageData.RI_Backstory_CultivatorAdult2.descriptio: [PAWN_nameDef]'s cultivation path was not smooth. After many years of hard work, [PAWN_nameDef] chose to let fate decide [PAWN_possessive] fortunes and live [PAWN_possessive] life unfettered by sect bureacracy or relationships.
LanguageData.RI_Backstory_CultivatorAdult3.title: avenging cultivator
LanguageData.RI_Backstory_CultivatorAdult3.descriptio: [PAWN_nameDef] once proudly practiced the art of cultivation in the pure pursuit of immortality. But when [PAWN_pronoun] was severely wounded in a siege against other cultivators, [PAWN_pronoun] only managed to flee at the cost of [PAWN_possessive] companions' lives. [PAWN_possessive] cultivation path twisted at that moment, and practicing cultivation became simply a tool for revenge.
LanguageData.RI_Backstory_CultivatorAdult4.title: deviant cultivator
LanguageData.RI_Backstory_CultivatorAdult4.descriptio: [PAWN_nameDef] suffered a disturbance during a critical moment of cultivation practice that afflicted [PAWN_objective] with Qi deviation. This left [PAWN_possessive] brain irreversibly altered: [PAWN_possessive] reasoning became erratic and [PAWN_possessive] temper, explosive. And, for some reason, [PAWN_pronoun] refuses to fight with anything but melee weapons.
LanguageData.RI_Backstory_CultivatorAdult5.title: demonic cultivator
LanguageData.RI_Backstory_CultivatorAdult5.descriptio: Kidnapping, stealing, robbing; the ends have always justified the means for [PAWN_nameDef] and there hasn't been a crime too heinous for [PAWN_nameDef] to commit yet. For the Dao contains all paths, including [PAWN_possessive].
LanguageData.RI_Backstory_Assassin1.title: high-profile assassin
LanguageData.RI_Backstory_Assassin1.description: [PAWN_nameDef] recently infiltrated a prominent nearby faction and killed its leader. The whole countryside has been hunting [PAWN_objective] down, but [PAWN_pronoun] has been living lavishly off of [PAWN_possessive] work's reward.
LanguageData.RI_Backstory_Assassin2.title: mercenary assassin
LanguageData.RI_Backstory_Assassin2.description: [PAWN_nameDef] wasn't fond of killing people, but [PAWN_pronoun] liked poverty even less.
LanguageData.RI_Backstory_SwordMan1.title: sword ghost
LanguageData.RI_Backstory_SwordMan1.description: [PAWN_nameDef] had always been committed to the study of swordsmanship. When [PAWN_pronoun] heard rumors of an acquaintance ridiculing [PAWN_possessive] martial knowledge, [PAWN_pronoun] found them and killed them in the street before fleeing.
LanguageData.RI_Backstory_SwordMan2.title: sword devil
LanguageData.RI_Backstory_SwordMan2.description: [PAWN_nameDef] always had an innate affinity for bladed weapons, but something changed when [PAWN_pronoun] lost a duel to a younger, less-experienced swordsman. [PAWN_pronoun] became obsessed with swords, gradually exceeding the bounds of any normal training. The sword became [PAWN_possessive] sole existence.
LanguageData.RI_Backstory_Adult1.title: vagrant
LanguageData.RI_Backstory_Adult1.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has worn many hats in many towns, forever the bystander. And along the way [PAWN_pronoun] has picked up the skills necessary to make [PAWN_possessive] way in the dangerous cultivation world.\nThere is always a wake in the aftermath of their movements as if there were something profound about them.
LanguageData.RI_Backstory_Adult2.title: money grubber
LanguageData.RI_Backstory_Adult2.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was both greedy and miserly. [PAWN_pronoun] would sooner die than let even solitary scrap of silver slip through [PAWN_possessive] fingers without blood in exchange.
